name: Arsenal MCP
description: A Kali Linux-based MCP server that exposes over 45 penetration testing tools for AI-assisted security auditing and vulnerability scanning. It features strict scope enforcement, structured output parsing, and persistent finding storage to automate the offensive security workflow.

rawRecord.description: A Kali Linux-based MCP server that exposes over 45 penetration testing tools for AI-assisted security auditing and vulnerability scanning. It features strict scope enforcement, structured output parsing, and persistent finding storage to automate the offensive security workflow.

DB_PATH.description: Path to SQLite database for persistence (default is ~/.arsenal/arsenal.db)

TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for tool execution in seconds (default is 300)

WORDLIST.description: Path to wordlist for tools like dirb (default is /usr/share/wordlists/dirb/common.txt)

PLUGIN_DIR.description: Directory containing custom tool plugins (default is ~/.arsenal/plugins)
